guide.title: Quick tour
guide.stepSummaryBody: The calorie ring and macro cards show your whole day at once. Tap a card to switch between "left" and "eaten".
guide.stepAddMealBody: "+ Add Meal" lets you log from Memory, Manually or with AI. Pick from Memory and the amount is scaled automatically for the serving you chose.
guide.stepMemoryBody: This is what makes Nutrimind different: the foods you save and the trigger words that call them up live in this tab. Add a food once, then reuse it with one tap.
guide.stepQuickBody: This button opens food search, meal and barcode scanning, and exercise logging from one place.
guide.stepProgressBody: Weekly history, trends, weight tracking and your streak are here. Tap a week to open its day details.
guide.stepSettingsBody: Goals, profile, language, appearance, data export and support all live here. You can replay this tour from here whenever you like.
